name: langflow
title: Langflow
description: Visual low-code platform for building, running, and deploying AI agents and workflows.
notes: Uses the official Langflow Docker image and PostgreSQL-backed deployment. CONTAINER_NAME controls the Langflow Docker container name; PostgreSQL uses the same prefix with -postgres. LANGFLOW_DATA_DIR is required and must be an absolute host path. The Langflow container starts as root only to create and chown its bind-mounted config directory, then drops to UID 1000 before starting Langflow. PostgreSQL initializes its own data directory. LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD and POSTGRES_PASSWORD are required and have no defaults. PostgreSQL is private to the stack and is not published on a host port.

env.name: CONTAINER_NAME
env.label: Container name
env.description: Docker container name for Langflow. PostgreSQL uses this name with the -postgres suffix.

env.name: LANGFLOW_VERSION
env.label: Image tag
env.description: Official langflowai/langflow image tag. Pulled on each stack deployment.

env.name: LANGFLOW_PORT
env.label: Web UI port
env.description: Host port mapped to Langflow's container port 7860.

env.name: LANGFLOW_DATA_DIR
env.label: Data directory
env.description: REQUIRED. Absolute host directory for persistent data. The stack creates langflow/ and postgres/ subdirectories inside it.

env.name: LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD
env.label: Admin pass
env.description: REQUIRED. Set a strong initial Langflow administrator password. No default password is supplied.

env.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.label: PostgreSQL pass
env.description: REQUIRED. Set a strong PostgreSQL password. No default password is supplied.
